title: An order with no matching customer has no r key at all
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
import * from dw::core::Arrays
output application/json
---
leftJoin([{orderId:'O3',customerId:99}], [{id:1,name:'Ann'}], (o) -> o.customerId as String, (c) -> c.id as String)

solution:
%dw 2.0
import * from dw::core::Arrays
output application/json
---
leftJoin([{orderId:'O3',customerId:99}], [{id:1,name:'Ann'}], (o) -> o.customerId as String, (c) -> c.id as String)

explanation.approach: Customer 99 does not exist, so the pair for order O3 has an `l` and nothing else — there is no `r` field to be null, it is simply absent.
